states.changed: A visitor drags a record's last day across two Ebola records and watches three rules for the quiets it cuts write three curves.

states.session: 2026-11-06 — thirty-fifth session — The Edge, second state
states.changed: A third stage, the rule's own day: for every day from 42 to 120 the visitor reads how many quiets that reached it broke within 90 days under each rule, beside the two days the literature argues over.

states.session: 2026-11-06 — thirty-sixth session — The Edge, third state
states.changed: Corrected: a quiet now begins the day after the rise, so breaks fall on the open file's days; a box reads the record the old way, and a line under the calendar says at every edge what the one day changes.

states.session: 2026-11-06 — thirty-seventh session — The Edge, fourth state
states.changed: With the edge moved back, a fourth line in amber shows what the record's later days wrote about the same quiets, so a visitor sees which rule the later record sided with at that edge; an opening line says what a quiet is, and the correction box moved into the method.

states.session: 2026-11-06 — thirty-eighth session — The Edge, fifth state
states.changed: Under the amber line three buttons read the later record itself as lost, carried or left out, and a count beneath says at how many edges each judge sides with each rule: carried and lost judges agree, and left out, made the judge, finds for itself at every edge of 2026.

states.session: 2026-11-06 — thirty-ninth session — The Edge, sixth state
states.changed: A strip under the judge's buttons sets every judged edge on the calendar, one row per judge, coloured by the rule each finds nearest; a visitor sees that the later record's verdicts come in seasons, and a click moves the edge to any of them.
